instruction: wc_words.c miscounts words that are separated by tabs or newlines. Fix it, build it with `gcc -O2 -o wc_words wc_words.c`, and check it with `python3 tools/compare.py`. Don't change tools/ or cases/.
check: gcc -O2 -o wc_words wc_words.c && python3 tools/compare.py && python3 "$KODACT_EVAL_TASK_DIR/hidden/check.py"
